checks.description: every $-form in the corpus whose BASE is a declared rune base is itself a declared rune — 0 unclassified of 78 dotted forms. This is the rule that found $state.eager and $effect.pending, which were publishing calls edges to framework plumbing.
all 20 declared runes positively probed: each is built into a snippet and asserted to emit no call edge to its leaf

all 6 user-namespace shapes positively probed to STILL emit their edges — $order.scoops, $value.foo, $formData.dob, $storeDeeper.items, and the two adversarial $my.eager / $my.pending that a bare-leaf fix for the missing runes would have silently swallowed

every directive prefix in the corpus (14 distinct) carries a declared obligation (10 families), with quoted values stripped so Tailwind tokens are never mistaken for directives. FOUND BY THIS CHECK: eight families were silent with no ruling anywhere — roughly 2,049 corpus occurrences including `bind:value` at 581. A node-type census could not have found it, because `attribute` was already marked handled and these families were hiding INSIDE that handled type. Probed in both directions: the read families must publish `uses`, the invoked families must publish `calls`, and `let:` must stay SILENT.

every `svelte:*` tag in the corpus is a declared builtin (10) or carries a REJECTED ruling (1); 0 undeclared of 11 tags. The prefix is reserved, so an undeclared member cannot name a component. FOUND BY THIS CHECK: the corpus's own compiler-errors sample `svelte:selfdestructive` was being published as `instantiates` AND derived identically by the F5 oracle, so both sides agreed and the differential reported it clean.

every block construct in the corpus carries a disposition (13 declared, 2 ruled rejected as invalid spellings in compiler-error samples); 0 undeclared of 15 constructs, so a block type Svelte adds later fails here rather than being silently unhandled on both sides.

every REJECTED ruling still matches something in the corpus. A ruling that no longer describes a real occurrence is deleted rather than left to excuse a name that has since become legal — otherwise the rejection table becomes a place to hide a newly-valid construct.
all 5 declared non-runes ($lib, $app, $$props, $$restProps, $$slots) confirmed present in the corpus, so no disposition is stale and doing no work

negativeControls: adding the bare leaf `eager`/`pending` to the segment set exits 1 naming $my.eager and $my.pending as SUPPRESSED
declaring a non-rune absent from the corpus exits 1 naming it stale
dropping the REJECTED ruling for svelte:selfdestructive exits 1 naming it an undeclared member of the reserved namespace
renaming a REJECTED ruling to a name the corpus lacks exits 1 naming the ruling stale
reverting the analyzer's reserved-namespace rule exits 1 reporting the undeclared member as PUBLISHED
a declared read family that stops publishing exits 1 naming the missing `uses` target
a declared invoked family that stops publishing exits 1 naming the missing `calls` target
a declared SILENT family that starts publishing exits 1 naming it
governance.why: A differential compares two readings of the same spec by the same author. A construct BOTH forgot cannot appear as a disagreement, so the lane reads 100% while the construct leaks. That is not hypothetical: this gate was written because the differential could not see the two missing runes.

limitations: Discovery is lexical over the corpus, so a construct written in a form this scan does not match would not be seen. The scan is a $-prefix scan with an optional single dotted segment; a two-segment form ($a.b.c) is counted as $a.b.

The completeness rule binds only forms whose base is a declared rune base. A new rune FAMILY ($newthing.x) would need its base declared, and until then it is classified as user data rather than failing — declared as a known gap rather than papered over.

This gate reads the corpus, not the analyzer's tables, so a rune the analyzer has never heard of and the corpus never uses is invisible to it. That is the $effect.untracked / $props.is_safe / $render case: 3 declared runes are corpus-absent and are carried on the spec surface, reported as such on every run.
title: svelte construct census — the check that consults neither the analyzer nor the oracle
